Mirrors docs/design/pallass-staging/phase-c-forward-references.json's shape (the 8e precedent).
finding_the_sell_verb_already_shipped: R5's plan text frames `sell`/`open_sell_picker`/WIShop.build_sell_graph as forward-referenced, not-yet-landed sibling work. On lane-cfB's tree it is ALREADY LIVE and fully wired for Krshia: data/dialogue/krshia_crate.json's hub carries 'I've a few things I don't need. Buying?' (effects:[{"open_sell_picker":true}], end:true, appended at array end -- the exact shape this staging doc's two new options mirror below), and src/core/wi_game.gd's dialogue_choose/_open_sell_dialogue/sell_item + src/core/shop.gd's WIShop.build_sell_graph implement the picker end to end (git history: predates the 2026-07-12 class-foundation plan commit, an earlier dialogue wave). Nothing further is needed for Krshia -- do not re-touch krshia_crate.json.
why_witch_and_stallkeeper_are_parked_not: src/core/shop.gd is HARDCODED single-vendor: `WIShop.SPEAKER := "Krshia"` plus Krshia-voiced HUB_TEXT/SOLD_TEXT/EMPTY_TEXT constants, and src/core/wi_game.gd's `_open_sell_dialogue()` calls `_begin_code_dialogue(WIShop.build_sell_graph(records), "krshia_sell", "krshia")` with the conversation id and entity id both literal. `sell_item()` also hardcodes the gold-earn provenance tag "krshia_sell". Wiring the witch's or stallkeeper's hub option to the SAME `{"open_sell_picker": true}` effect today would open a conversation captioned "Krshia" inside Eloise's cottage or the Pallass market -- a real character-voice bug (violates docs/design/character-profiles.md's per-character contract), even though test_content.gd's `_validate_effect` would not flag the option itself (it only validates KNOWN effect keys' referenced ids, not effect-key completeness, and open_sell_picker IS already a known key). This is a functional/narrative blocker, not a validator-failure -- the plan's own 'park if it won't validate' escape hatch is applied here in spirit: shipping a mislabeled vendor conversation is worse than shipping nothing.

generalization_needed.shop_gd: WIShop.build_sell_graph(records, speaker: String, hub_text: String, sold_text: String, empty_text: String) -- 4 new params replacing the 4 hardcoded constants; SPEAKER/HUB_TEXT/SOLD_TEXT/EMPTY_TEXT become Krshia's own call-site arguments (the caller's default), not class constants.
generalization_needed.wi_game_gd: _open_sell_dialogue(vendor_speaker: String, vendor_entity_id: String, vendor_conversation_id: String, hub_text: String, sold_text: String, empty_text: String) or a small per-vendor lookup table keyed by the calling entity's conversation id (the board/delivery picker precedent uses a single global picker because there is only ONE Request Board; a multi-vendor sell surface is closer to the encounter/on_skill_use per-entity dispatch shape already in wi_game.gd's interact() switch -- controller's call which idiom fits). sell_item()'s hardcoded "krshia_sell" gold-provenance tag should likewise become a passed-through vendor tag (cosmetic -- provenance strings are logging/loot-isolation keys, never player-visible, so this is a low-risk rename, not a new mechanism).
